title: Console Tooling Standup 2026-05-26
body:
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Marta, Jun, Samir

Quick status updates:
- UI (Priya / Ethan):
  - New rollout UX: initial design shipped to repo (PR 487). Ethan finished the top-level layout; still working on region selection edge cases.
  - Accessibility pass needed for modal dialogs; identified missing focus trap on canary modal. TODO: Ethan to add fix, estimate 1d.
  - Known visual regression in policy table when feature flags off; temporary CSS patch merged but needs follow-up to avoid flicker.

- Rollouts (Marta / Jun):
  - Canary rollout framework: backend gating logic for model variant routing is in staging. Jun verified traffic-splitting for 5% canary - metrics look stable.
  - Auto-fallback policy: prototype implemented, but we saw a regression where fallback fires too aggressively when p99 spikes ~600ms. Marta to tune thresholds and add smoother decay.
  - Next sprint: add per-tenant rollout controls (RED-1189). Blocker: need final schema change in rollout-service (waiting on infra DB migration window).

- Analytics & Observability (Samir):
  - Grafana dashboard refreshed; added per-route token-cost panel and a new heatmap for sequence-length distribution. Link in linked_artifacts.
  - Alert noise: two alerts firing due to transient GC pauses on dedicated nodes. Samir suggests suppressing alerts during nightly compaction window and is drafting a proposal.
  - Latency regression: small increase in median for small payloads after batching change. Working with serving-runtime to chase down batching thresholds.

Blockers / Risks:
- DB migration window for rollout schema (blocks per-tenant rollout work). Owner: Marta. ETA: waiting on infra team's migration slots (requested for 2026-06-02).
- Accessibility bug in canary modal (blocks release for some customers). Owner: Ethan. ETA: 2026-05-27.
- Aggressive fallback policy causing customer-facing errors in staging under traffic burst. Owner: Marta/Jun. Mitigation: revert to previous policy if not resolved by EOD tomorrow.

Action items:
- Ethan: add focus trap to canary modal, add unit/integration test for keyboard nav. (ETA 2026-05-27)
- Marta: follow up with infra on DB migration slot and prepare migration plan (ETA 2026-05-28).
- Jun: add smoother decay to fallback heuristic and add canary-specific logging to trace triggers. (ETA 2026-05-28)
- Samir: propose alert suppression window and tune GC-triggered alerts; open PR with alert rules (ETA 2026-05-29).
- Priya: assemble short customer note draft for internal ops if we need to rollback canary (have template ready).

Notes / loose threads:
- Consider adding a "dry-run" mode for rollout policy changes to preview routing without affecting production metrics. Parking this as a follow-up for planning.
- Need to decide on the default threshold for batching small requests; impacts both latency and cost. Suggest a quick A/B with 10% traffic today to gather numbers.
- Remind: sync with Solutions Eng next Wed to demo per-tenant rollouts prototype.

Meeting adjourned. Next standup: 2026-06-02.

Raw links and refs:
- PR 487: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/487
- JIRA RED-1123 (canary fallback tuning), RED-1189 (per-tenant rollouts)
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/console/console-latency
- Confluence notes: /pages/viewpage.action?pageId=84234

NotesToSelf: keep this doc as the single source for weekly runbook items until we move to Confluence. Save final action items to the sprint board before EOD.
